message_text: What are the different dorm options for freshmen?

Freshmen can choose from: Traditional halls (shared rooms, communal bathrooms - $4,200/semester), Suite-style (shared room, private bathroom - $5,100/semester), or Apartment-style (single room, shared kitchen - $5,800/semester).
Can I request a specific roommate?
Yes! Both you and your preferred roommate need to list each other in the housing application. The system will match you automatically.
That's awesome. Do all rooms come with WiFi?
Yes, all residential halls have high-speed WiFi included at no additional cost. Each room also has ethernet ports for wired connections.
Great, this is very clear. Thanks!
You're welcome! Let me know if you have any other housing questions.
